notes: All 36 rows CONFIRMED. Sources actually opened this pass: (1) codes.ohio.gov R.C. 149.43 current version — page states eff. Sept. 30, 2025 (H.B. 96) with a later version eff. Sept. 7, 2026 (H.B. 31), matching every row's effective_status; (2) the Sept. 7, 2026 pending version — all eight fee/payment clauses ((B)(1) at-cost, $75/$750 video caps, 5-business-day estimate, 20% overrun pair, (B)(6), (B)(7)(a), (B)(11), (E)(2)) present unchanged, confirming the raw file's 'does not touch the fee language' claim; (3) Hutson 1994-Ohio-5 PDF (text-extracted) — paras. 25-26 and syllabus verbatim, municipal respondent; (4) AG 2026 Sunshine Laws Manual PDF (text-extracted) — all four quoted guidance sentences verbatim with footnotes matching the rows' case citations; (5) AG Model Public Records Policy PDF (text-extracted) — '[X] cents per page'/'[X] per disc' placeholders and delivery/e-mail lines verbatim, document undated as flagged; (6) R.C. 5502.12 — $4 accident-report fee verbatim, eff. 2009; (7) OAG 99-012 PDF (text-extracted) — syllabus para. 2 verbatim, county addressee as the row flags. Also confirmed: 'ninety-five per cent' is absent from R.C. 149.43 (supporting the OH-9006 correction of OH-0026), and R.C. 149.43(F) BMV bulk-extraction +10% is agency-only and nowhere recorded as a municipal figure. Resolution words all check: no ceiling recorded as a value; the soft 'at cost' standard rows carry null values; the two numeric rows (av 75|750; revision-notify 20%) are true statutory ceilings ('not to exceed' / 'shall not ... exceed') scoped and flagged as law-enforcement/prosecutor-video record-specific, which does bind municipal police. Rows resting on Official Guidance (estimateNotifyThreshold, payment.nonpayment, certification) honestly carry source_type 'Official Guidance', medium confidence, and manual_verification flags for the un-opened underlying opinions (Ware v. Akron, Fragale, Dehler, Mobley) — the guidance documents themselves were opened and the quotes are verbatim, so the rows are CONFIRMED as recorded.
